column1: # The hosted crate repositories auto-tag.sh may tag, in dependency order: a
# repository is listed after everything it depends on, so the pin bumps stack in
# this order and main never pins a mismatched pair. The set must match
# .cargo/hosted-pin-refs.tsv exactly; adding a hosted crate is a deliberate edit
# of both files, reviewed like any other change.

column2: rank (lower is tagged and bumped first)
